en.t: No, no, I have to go back!

units.source_text: 还有另一个宴会，大家都跟着去陪第二个宴会了，就只有我留下来。

en.t: There is another party too, and everyone has gone along to keep company at the second party; I am the only one left behind.

units.source_text: 要是宴会在这儿举行还可以，

en.t: It would be all right if the party were being held here,

units.source_text: 不然朋友们回头找我去洗澡，

en.t: otherwise, if my friends come back later looking for me to go take a bath,
and I am not at home, that would be bad.
